interface: openhands_xml_v1: unconstrained text function calls with optional reasoning before exactly one complete function. Match released function/parameter tags and parameter whitespace stripping. Unlike the producer's repair helper, do not synthesize closing tags or strip fences. Malformed/unsupported calls return explicit controller observations and consume slots, with all raw text retained.
tools: Bounded adapters for execute_bash, finish, str_replace_editor. No OpenHands CLI/service or arbitrary shell is invoked. Commands map only to declared read-only repository inspections and yarnjest; no pipelines, redirection, scripts, network, Git history or mutation commands. File changes use existing exact edit/new-file write operations. Add file/directory views with extent metadata and Git-ignore-aware filename glob discovery, preserving existing output/scan/read limits. This supported subset differs from the unrestricted producer scaffold and is not concealed.
failure_policy: failure_aware_v4 retains exact action hashes but scopes deterministic failure certificates to relevant state. Failed tests expire only after a genuine edit/write advances workspace revision; edit mismatches expire only after affected-file change; missing-path certificates use workspace revision; other invalid inputs remain permanent. Reads, failed/no-op edits and unrelated-file changes do not unlock failed edits. Only successful nonempty file views refresh edit evidence; filename-only find never does. Raw history stays in audit; bounded prompt state carries current active constraints. Verification remains required until a later successful test.
repeat_metrics: Report raw same-action retries across genuine state changes separately from unchanged-state known-failed re-executions. Do not salt hashes or relabel raw retries as zero. Required controller property is zero physical re-execution of a still-active failure certificate; a legitimate post-edit test rerun is not a deterministic retry against the old state.
